correctness.rationale: For every induced vertex subset, complete-graph edges and coning of each missing Fano-line triangle prove simple connectivity from four vertices onward. Distinct cap tetrahedra have no common triangular faces, permitting complete elementary collapse to dimension two; the Euler-characteristic formula yields exactly the stated integral wedges. The same unique-triangle property proves all degree-two inclusion homomorphisms injective over integers. Exact rational elimination checks all 127 induced subcomplexes; signed simplicial Lefschetz traces exhaust the 168 collineations and the standard character table yields rational irreducibility. The 21 five-point images span by transitivity and irreducibility. Computations are finite exhaustive checks, not replacements for the elementary topological proof.

value.rationale: The seven-point Fano plane is the smallest nontrivial projective plane and its nonincidence graph is a canonical dual counterpart to the classical Heawood incidence graph. The theorem gives a complete local-to-global homology-support classification for all 127 vertex restrictions, with a sharp five-vertex threshold, exactly 21 minimal carriers, injectivity of every integral degree-two inclusion and a natural irreducible collineation action. These are structurally motivated invariants of this natural finite geometry rather than arbitrary parameters or a rank-only recomputation. No all-orders generalization is claimed.
